publication.title: Graphical Query Builder in Opportunistic Sensor Networks to discover Sensor Information
publication.version: Published February 2011 article; PDF preflight unavailable

source_reading.scope: Abstract, graphical design/workflow, implementation platform, functional tests, lack of user testing and future communication/complex-query work (§§4–9).

adjudication.basis: The implemented ontology-guided graph query canvas validates selected classes/properties, generates SPARQL and saves the query. It is a primary RDF-query interaction/guidance prototype in the sensor-KG setting. The protocol does not require deployed execution; communication with TOppS remains future work and is not coded as implemented.

tasks: Pizza/Wine/sensor ontology reading and simple query translation examples

descriptions.interaction: Load OWL file, inspect classes/properties, manually select query elements, create graphical triple patterns, view generated SPARQL and save text.
descriptions.guidance: Validate selected query elements against loaded ontology.
descriptions.evaluation: Functional OWL parsing tests with Pizza, Wine and sensor ontologies; manually checked sample query/translation outputs.
